planets.name: WASP-130 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-130 with a 11.6-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: WASP-130 b was found in 2016 by SuperWASP-South as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-130. Its orbit and size follow Hellier et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname HELLIER_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2016, disc_facility SuperWASP-South, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 11.5509734, pl_radj 0.89, pl_bmassj 1.23
